title: Step 4 - Fully Connected Layers in CNNs: Optimizing Feature Combination

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back to the course on Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到深度學習課程。

cues.en: Today we're finally at step number four, Full Connection.
cues.zh: 今天終於來到第四步：全連接。

cues.en: So what is this step all about?
cues.zh: 這一步究竟做什麼？

cues.en: Well, in this step we're adding a whole artificial neural network to our convolution neural network.
cues.zh: 我們要在卷積神經網路裡，加上一整個人工神經網路。

cues.en: So to all of the things that we've done so far which are convolution, pooling, and flattening now we're adding a whole new A and N on the back of that.
cues.zh: 也就是在已完成的卷積、池化與攤平之後，再接上一個全新的 ANN。

cues.en: How intense is that?
cues.zh: 是不是很厲害？

cues.en: That is something, that is definitely something.
cues.zh: 這確實很不簡單。

cues.en: And so here we've got the input layer.
cues.zh: 這裡有輸入層，

cues.en: We've got a fully connected layer and output layer.
cues.zh: 接著是全連接層與輸出層。

cues.en: And by the way the fully connected layer in the artificial neural networks we used to call them hidden layers and here we're calling them fully connected layers because they are hidden layers, but at the same time
cues.zh: 順帶一提，人工神經網路裡的全連接層，之前稱為隱藏層；現在這樣稱呼，是因為它們雖然是隱藏層，同時也是

cues.en: they're a more specific type of hidden layers.
cues.zh: 一種更特定的隱藏層。

cues.en: They're fully connected layer.
cues.zh: 它們是全連接層。

cues.en: In artificial neural networks, hidden layers don't have to be fully connected whereas in convolution neural networks we're gonna be using fully connected layers,
cues.zh: 人工神經網路的隱藏層不一定要全連接，但這裡的卷積神經網路會使用全連接層，

cues.en: and that's why they're generally called fully connected layers.
cues.zh: 因此通常就稱為全連接層。

cues.en: And so basically that whole column or vector of outputs that we have after the flattening, we are passing it into the input layer.
cues.zh: 基本上，把攤平後得到的整個直行，也就是輸出向量，傳入輸入層。

cues.en: And here we've got a very simplified example just for illustration purposes.
cues.zh: 這裡為了方便說明，用了很簡化的例子。

cues.en: And what the main purpose of the artificial neural network is is to combine our features into more attributes that predict the classes even better.
cues.zh: 人工神經網路的主要目的，是結合特徵形成更多屬性，讓類別預測更好。

cues.en: So we already, in our vector of outputs, in the flattened result from what we've already done
cues.zh: 前面處理後得到的攤平輸出向量，

cues.en: we have some features encoded in the numbers in that vector.
cues.zh: 其中的數字已經編碼了一些特徵。

cues.en: And they can already do probably a pretty good job at predicting what's class we're looking at.
cues.zh: 光靠它們，可能就能相當不錯地預測目前是哪個類別，

cues.en: Whether it's a dog or a cat, or whether it's a tumor or not a tumor and so on.
cues.zh: 例如是狗還是貓、有腫瘤還是沒有腫瘤等等。

cues.en: But at the same time, we know that we have this structure called artificial neural network which is designed, which has a purpose
cues.zh: 同時，我們也知道有個稱為人工神經網路的結構，它就是設計來

cues.en: of dealing with attributes and coming up, or dealing with features and coming up with new attributes and combining attributes together
cues.zh: 處理屬性或特徵，產生新屬性、結合不同屬性，

cues.en: to even better predict things that we're trying to predict.
cues.zh: 讓我們想預測的事情預測得更好。

cues.en: And we know that from the previous part.
cues.zh: 上一個部分已經學過。

cues.en: So why not leverage that?
cues.zh: 所以何不運用它？

cues.en: And that's exactly what the plan here is.
cues.zh: 這正是這裡的計畫。

cues.en: So how about we pass on those values into an artificial neural network and let it even further optimize everything that we're doing?
cues.zh: 把那些數值傳入人工神經網路，讓它進一步最佳化整個處理流程，如何？

cues.en: And so that's what we're going to be doing.
cues.zh: 我們就要這麼做。

cues.en: But let's look at a more realistic example, because this one is a bit too simple.
cues.zh: 但先看一個更實際的例子，剛才那個太簡單了。

cues.en: So here we've got a better looking artificial neural network where we have five attributes on the inputs.
cues.zh: 這個人工神經網路更像樣，輸入有五個屬性。

cues.en: Then in the first hidden layer we have six neurons.
cues.zh: 第一個隱藏層有六個神經元。

cues.en: In the second fully connected layer we have eight neurons and then we have two outputs, one for dog and one for cat.
cues.zh: 第二個全連接層有八個神經元，再來有兩個輸出，一個代表狗，一個代表貓。

cues.en: And so an important thing for us to talk about here is that why do we have two outputs?
cues.zh: 這裡有個重要問題：為什麼有兩個輸出？

cues.en: We are kind of used to having only one output in our artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 之前我們習慣人工神經網路只有一個輸出。

cues.en: Well, one output is for kind of when you're predicting a numerical value when you're running a regression type of problem.
cues.zh: 如果做迴歸問題，預測一個數值，就用一個輸出。

cues.en: But when you're doing classification you need an output per class.
cues.zh: 分類問題則每個類別需要一個輸出。

cues.en: Exception is when you have just two classes.
cues.zh: 只有兩個類別時是例外。

cues.en: Like we have two classes here, dog and cat and we could've just done one output and made it a binary output and said one is a dog and zero is a cat.
cues.zh: 例如這裡只有狗與貓，也能只用一個二元輸出，1 代表狗，0 代表貓。

cues.en: And that would've worked totally fine.
cues.zh: 這樣完全可行。

cues.en: And actually, in fact you'll see lon do that in the practical tutorials and that's how they'll be structured.
cues.zh: 實作教學裡你也會看到講師這樣做，程式會採用那種結構。

cues.en: But at the same time, if you have more than two categories, for instance, dogs, cats, and birds then you have to have a neuron per every category.
cues.zh: 但如果超過兩類，例如狗、貓、鳥，就必須每類用一個神經元。

cues.en: And that's why we're going to practice with two categories in this example, so that we know what to expect if we ever have more than two categories.
cues.zh: 這個例子因此用兩個輸出來練習，讓我們知道以後超過兩類時會是什麼樣子。

cues.en: And so what's going to be happening here?
cues.zh: 接下來會怎樣？

cues.en: So we've already done all the groundwork, we've done the convolution, we've done the pooling and the flattening, and now the information's gonna go through the artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 基礎工作都做完了，包括卷積、池化與攤平，現在資訊要通過人工神經網路。

cues.en: So let's have a look at how all that all happens.
cues.zh: 來看整個過程。

cues.en: There's the information going through from the very start from the moment when the image is processed, then convolved, then pooled, flattened,
cues.zh: 資訊從最一開始處理影像，接著卷積、池化、攤平，

cues.en: and then through the artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 再通過人工神經網路。

cues.en: All four steps.
cues.zh: 總共四個步驟。

cues.en: And then a prediction is made.
cues.zh: 最後做出預測。

cues.en: And we'll see how this happens in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到如何進行。

cues.en: It will be very, very interesting.
cues.zh: 會非常有意思。

cues.en: But for now let's just say a prediction is made and for instance, 80% that it's a dog, but it turns out to be a cat.
cues.zh: 目前先假設得到預測，例如 80% 是狗，但實際卻是貓。

cues.en: And then an error is calculated.
cues.zh: 接著計算誤差。

cues.en: What we used to call a cross function in a artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 在人工神經網路裡，之前稱為成本函數。

cues.en: And we use the means squared error there, or in convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 當時用均方誤差，而在卷積神經網路裡，

cues.en: It's called a loss function.
cues.zh: 則稱為損失函數。

cues.en: And we use a cross entropy function for that.
cues.zh: 這裡使用交叉熵函數。

cues.en: And we'll talk about cross entropy and means squared errors in a separate tutorial and how all that happens.
cues.zh: 交叉熵、均方誤差及其運作，會另外用一堂課討論。

cues.en: But for now, let's just say we have a loss type of function which tells us how well our network is performing and we're trying to optimize it or minimize that function to optimize our network.
cues.zh: 目前先知道有一個損失函數，告訴我們網路表現如何，我們試著最佳化，也就是最小化它，來最佳化網路。

cues.en: So the error is calculated, then it's back propagated through the network, just like we had in the artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 計算誤差後，就像人工神經網路一樣，把誤差反向傳播回網路。

cues.en: Is back propagated and some things are adjusted in the network to help optimize the performance.
cues.zh: 反向傳播時會調整網路中的某些東西，改善表現。

cues.en: And the things that are adjusted are as usual.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，要調整的是

cues.en: The weights in the artificial neural network parts.
cues.zh: 人工神經網路部分的權重，

cues.en: So the the blue lines that you see here, the synopsis.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡的藍色線條，突觸連線。

cues.en: Then also another thing that is adjusted is the feature detectors.
cues.zh: 另外還會調整特徵偵測器。

cues.en: So we know that we're looking for features but what if we're looking for the wrong features?
cues.zh: 我們知道要找特徵，但如果找錯了呢？

cues.en: What if this didn't work out because the features are incorrect?
cues.zh: 如果表現不好，是因為特徵不對呢？

cues.en: And so the feature detectors, remember those little matrices that we had that the three by three matrices?
cues.zh: 還記得那些 3 × 3 的小矩陣，也就是特徵偵測器嗎？

cues.en: They are adjusted so that maybe next time it'll be better and let's see what happens type of thing.
cues.zh: 它們也會調整，讓下一次可能表現更好，再看看結果。

cues.en: But of course it's all done with a lot of science in the background with a lot of math and it's all done through gradient descent with back propagation.
cues.zh: 當然，背後有很多科學與數學，透過梯度下降和反向傳播進行。

cues.en: So it's all not just random perturbations it's actually very thought through how it's done.
cues.zh: 不是隨機亂改，而是有周密的方法。

cues.en: But nevertheless, the feature detectors are adjusted, the weights are adjusted and this whole process happens again.
cues.zh: 總之，特徵偵測器與權重都會調整，再重複整個流程。

cues.en: And then again the error is back propagated.
cues.zh: 誤差再度反向傳播，

cues.en: And this keeps going on and on and on.
cues.zh: 不斷持續進行。

cues.en: And that's how our network is optimized.
cues.zh: 網路就是這樣最佳化的。

cues.en: That's how our network trains on the data.
cues.zh: 也是這樣根據資料訓練的。

cues.en: So the important thing here is that the data goes through the whole network from the very start to the very end, then the error is compared,
cues.zh: 重點是資料從頭到尾通過整個網路，再進行比較，

cues.en: so the error is calculated and then is back propagated.
cues.zh: 計算誤差，然後反向傳播。

cues.en: So same story as with artificial neuro networks just a bit longer because of that whole the first three steps that we already had.
cues.zh: 與人工神經網路相同，只是多了前面三個步驟，所以流程長一些。

cues.en: And now let's have a look at the really interesting part.
cues.zh: 現在來看真正有趣的部分。

cues.en: How do these two classes work?
cues.zh: 這兩個類別如何運作？

cues.en: Or how do these two output neurons work?
cues.zh: 或者說，這兩個輸出神經元如何運作？

cues.en: Because before we've always kind of had one output neuron.
cues.zh: 因為之前一直只有一個輸出神經元。

cues.en: What happens when we have two?
cues.zh: 有兩個時會怎樣？

cues.en: How how do this situation of classification of images play out?
cues.zh: 影像分類這種情況會如何進行？

cues.en: Well, let's start with the top neuron first.
cues.zh: 先從上方的神經元開始。

cues.en: We're gonna start with the dog.
cues.zh: 先看狗。

cues.en: How do we, the main purpose, what we need to do first is we need to understand what weights to assign to all of these synopsis that connect to the dog
cues.zh: 首先必須理解，如何為所有連接到狗的突觸指定權重，

cues.en: so that we know which of the previous neurons are actually important for the dog.
cues.zh: 才能知道前一層哪些神經元對狗真正重要。

cues.en: And let's see how that is done.
cues.zh: 來看看如何做到。

cues.en: So let's say hypothetically we've got these numbers in our previous fully connected, or in the final fully connected layer.
cues.zh: 假設前一個，也就是最後的全連接層裡，有這些數值。

cues.en: And again, these numbers can be absolutely anything.
cues.zh: 這些數字其實可以是任何值。

cues.en: They don't have to be that, they can be any numbers, but just for arguments sake, we're going to agree that we are looking specifically at numbers between zero and one.
cues.zh: 不一定是這些，但為了方便討論，我們先限定看 0 到 1 之間的數字。

cues.en: So it's easier for us to argue these things and understand.
cues.zh: 這樣比較容易解釋、理解。

cues.en: And one means that that neuron was very confident that it found a certain feature.
cues.zh: 1 表示該神經元非常有把握，找到了某個特徵。

cues.en: And zero is going to mean that that neuron didn't find a feature is looking for.
cues.zh: 0 表示沒有找到它要找的特徵。

cues.en: So, because at the end of the day, these neurons, and like of anything else on this left side is just looking at features at an image.
cues.zh: 畢竟這些神經元，以及左邊所有處理，都是在看影像中的特徵。

cues.en: This is already very, very processed but still it's detecting a certain feature or combination of features on the image.
cues.zh: 雖然已經過大量處理，但仍在偵測某個特徵或特徵組合。

cues.en: Before in the convolve step we had kind of recognizable features in the pool step, they're less recognizable, then they become even less recognizable in the flatten image and then they get combined and so on.
cues.zh: 卷積步驟中還看得出特徵，池化後較難辨認，攤平後更難，再繼續結合等等。

cues.en: But nevertheless, this we are talking about here certain features that are present image or their combination.
cues.zh: 不過，我們談的仍然是影像中存在的特徵或其組合。

cues.en: So a one which has been passed, and this is important has been passed to both the dog and the cat at the same time to both the output neurons.
cues.zh: 這個 1 會同時傳給狗和貓，也就是同時傳給兩個輸出神經元，這點很重要。

cues.en: So one means that for us, for our argument, it means that this neuron is firing up.
cues.zh: 在這個例子的設定中，1 表示這個神經元被激活了。

cues.en: It's really rapidly detecting that feature that might be an eyebrow.
cues.zh: 它很強烈地偵測到某個特徵，例如眉毛。

cues.en: It might be detecting this eyebrow again for simplicity's sake is detecting this eyebrow, and it's communicating that to the dog neuron to the cat neuron saying, "I can see my eyebrow, I can see my eyebrow."
cues.zh: 為了簡化，假設它偵測到眉毛，並告訴狗和貓的神經元：「我看到眉毛了，我看到眉毛了。」

cues.en: And then it's up to the dog and the cat neuron to understand what that means for them.
cues.zh: 接著由狗和貓神經元判斷，這對自己代表什麼。

cues.en: And so in this case, which neurons are firing up?
cues.zh: 這個例子有哪些神經元被激活？

cues.en: These three neurons are firing up.
cues.zh: 這三個。

cues.en: the eyebrow, and let's say the nose is saying, "I can see a big nose and I can see floppy ears."
cues.zh: 眉毛，再假設鼻子說：「我看到大鼻子」，另一個說：「我看到下垂的耳朵。」

cues.en: So and it's saying that to the dog and to the cat.
cues.zh: 它們同時告訴狗和貓。

cues.en: And then what happens is we know that this is a dog.
cues.zh: 我們知道這張是狗。

cues.en: So the dog neuron knows that the answer it is actually a dog because at the end we are comparing to the picture or to the label on the picture,
cues.zh: 狗神經元也知道答案是狗，因為最後會與圖片，或圖片上的標籤比較，

cues.en: and it knows a dog.
cues.zh: 因此知道是狗。

cues.en: So basically the dog neurons gonna say, "Aha so I should be triggered in this case, so these are my neurons."
cues.zh: 狗神經元會想：「原來這時候我應該被激活，這些就是對我有用的神經元。」

cues.en: They're telling this signal that they're sending to both to me, to the dog and to the cat is actually an indication for me that it is a dog.
cues.zh: 它們同時傳給狗與貓的訊號，對狗神經元而言，是表示這是狗的線索。

cues.en: And throughout these lots and lots and lots of iterations if this happens many times the dog will learn that these neurons do indeed fire up when the feature belongs to a dog.
cues.zh: 經過大量迭代，如果這種情況經常發生，狗神經元就學會：特徵屬於狗時，這些神經元確實會激活。

cues.en: On the other hand, the cat neuron will know that it's not a cat, and it will know that this feature is firing up, and this neuron is telling me it can see floppy ears, floppy ears, floppy ears,
cues.zh: 另一方面，貓神經元知道這不是貓，也知道這個神經元一直激活，說它看到下垂耳朵、下垂耳朵、下垂耳朵，

cues.en: but at the same time it's not a cat.
cues.zh: 但這同時又不是貓。

cues.en: So basically, to me that's the signal that I should ignore this neuron, and the more that happens, the more the cat neuron is gonna ignore this neuron about the floppy ears.
cues.zh: 因此這表示應該忽略該神經元。發生次數越多，貓神經元越會忽略這個代表下垂耳朵的神經元。

cues.en: And so basically that's how through lots and lots of iterations, if this happens often.
cues.zh: 基本上就是透過大量迭代，如果這種情況經常發生，

cues.en: So this is just one example but if this happens often, maybe a one, maybe a 0.8, 0.9 maybe sometimes it won't fire.
cues.zh: 這裡只是一個例子，實際上可能輸出 1、0.8、0.9，有時甚至不激活。

cues.en: But overall, on average, this neuron is lighting up very often when it is indeed a dog, the dog neuron will start attributing higher importance
cues.zh: 但平均而言，真正是狗時，這個神經元常常亮起來，狗神經元就會賦予它更高的

cues.en: to this neuron.
cues.zh: 重要性。

cues.en: And so there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's how we're going to signify it.
cues.zh: 我們用這種方式表示。

cues.en: We're going to say that these three neurons through this iterative process with many, many, many, many samples and many many epox remember, so a sample is rowing your dataset.
cues.zh: 透過許多樣本與許多訓練週期的反覆過程，這三個神經元就學會了。記得，樣本是資料集中的一列，

cues.en: And epoch is when you go through your whole dataset again and again and again through lots and lots of iterations, this dog neuron learned that this eyebrow neuron
cues.zh: 完整跑過整個資料集一次是一個訓練週期。經過大量迭代，狗神經元學到，這個眉毛神經元、

cues.en: and this big nose neuron and this floppy ear neuron, they all seem to really contribute very well
cues.zh: 大鼻子神經元與下垂耳朵神經元，似乎都很有助於

cues.en: to the classification of what it's looking for and which is a dog.
cues.zh: 它要辨識的類別，也就是狗。

cues.en: So that's how it works.
cues.zh: 這就是運作方式。

cues.en: And again, these ears and nose and eyebrows, those are very very approximate or like very far fetched examples because by this stage
cues.zh: 再次強調，耳朵、鼻子、眉毛只是非常粗略，甚至有點牽強的例子，因為到了

cues.en: in this whole convolution neural network, it is completely unrecognizable what they're looking for.
cues.zh: 卷積神經網路這個階段，已完全看不出它們在尋找什麼。

cues.en: But at the same time, it is something in the features of dogs or cats or whatever you're classifying.
